Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the ghost tour. My name is Jack, and I am the guide who will take you through the dark streets tonight. We start here, at the old city gates, which are more than two hundred years old. Look at the small house next to the gates. A young woman called Elizabeth lived there, a long time ago. People say she waited every night for a man who never came back. Today, some visitors say they see a light in the window, like a candle. Is it Elizabeth? I do not know. Stay close to me, and let's walk to the next house, where the story is even stranger.

Hello, and welcome to the St. Augustine Lighthouse. I am a volunteer here, and I love this place. The tower which you see today was finished in 1874. There are two hundred and nineteen steps to the top, so take your time, and drink some water first. The keepers, who took care of the light, lived with their families in the house next to the tower. Today, that house is a museum where you can see how they lived. From the top, you can see the ocean, the beaches and the whole historic city. Enjoy the climb!

Our tour starts at the city gates, where we meet our guide. Then we visit the fort which the Spanish built. After that, we walk down the street where there are no cars. Next, we see the hotel which Henry Flagler opened in 1888. Finally, we climb the lighthouse that has two hundred and nineteen steps.
